implementation: Shared128/64-reduction operand views use the already exact scaled-half decomposition with original BF16 fallback. Each K16 row is36 bytes. Single-lane and four-lane dots retain original sequential carries. WU captures all owned V cells before any U write, preserving U=V ownership. WU/output cache the unchanged per-token exponential rather than repeating it per column; state already caches per-token/chunk decay. Original BF16 checkpoints/residuals, FP32 state layout and final FMA ordering remain. The new header is isolated from product dispatch.
correctness_scope: Six logical lengths1/63/64/65/129/1024, zero/finite/subnormal cases, three variants and two alias policies produce108 native reports. Every output, final state, W/U projection, BF16 state checkpoint and residual matches the original scalar baseline. Independent CPU columns verify WU and full recurrent/output equations for zero and finite inputs; subnormal cases compare against the full original GPU algorithm. q8192 verifies the complete generated WU/state/output chain on one warmup and three rotating measured attempts. Inputs, inactive alias storage and guards are checked. No new GB10 operator or end-to-end token boundary is measured.
timing_scope: The full q8192 clock includes shared preparation, WU, complete8192-row state recurrence and output in stream order. Allocation, resets, validation and exponential-table upload are outside the clock. This generated component omits KKT/inverse generation and all other model stages. Safety reports have zero measured attempts; their zero-valued timing fields are placeholders, not performance measurements. Single-lane candidate samples vary substantially and are not a qualified gain.
decision: Do not integrate on the joint timing alone. Current/prepared-scalar/prepared-four-lane medians are79.7740/75.0824/121.5630ms with separate U and81.4389/78.0073/122.4382ms with U=V. All raw numerical comparisons pass, but the scalar gain is small and variable while four-lane execution regresses. Add component phase observations before choosing whether any individual surface merits a broader follow-up; do not infer real-model TTFT from these generated timings.
